crossRefs.note: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the…

translations.web: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
translations.bsb: When hay is removed and new growth appears and the grass from the hills is gathered,
translations.kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
translations.asv: The hay is carried, and the tender grass showeth itself, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in.
